system.description:
The light of God, by whatever name you use, shines from your soul. You have one Trait of True Faith, usable as a Willpower Trait. You may also repel vampires: brandishing a holy symbol and winning a Social Challenge sends the target fleeing, and even on a loss the opponent cannot come within 10 feet unless he overbids you in a Willpower test.

You must keep a Morality of five Humanity Traits, and Storytellers demand a very good explanation for this exceedingly rare Merit.
system.source: Laws of the Night Revised, Character Creation and Traits
